newsitem.title: USA: Three-Five wins order from new customer.
newsitem.headline: Three-Five wins order from new customer.

text.p: Three-Five Systems Inc said on Wednesday it will produce a liquid crystal display module for a postal weighing system, marking a new original equipment manufacturer client and a diversification for the company.
The order is for an unnamed, U.S.-based maker of scales and weighing systems. Financial terms were undisclosed, but Three-Five expects revenue from it in 1996's fourth quarter.

"We are currently sole supplier on this program which has its application in the office automation market, a key growth area for our products and services," Vincent Hren, vice president of operations," said in a statement.
